The Format & Formula

Three events.
One combined time.

Final Time = Triathlon Time + Golf Adj. − Beer Bonus

01 Endurance

Do a triathlon

Base Time: Start with your official triathlon chip finish time converted entirely into total minutes.

Units: Minutes + Standard Clock
02 On The Course

Play a round

Golf Adjustment: Based on 36 Stableford points (2 pts Par, 1 pt Bogey, 3 pts Birdie):

  • +2 mins for each point under 36
  • −2 mins for each point over 36
Baseline: 36 Pts ± 2 Mins / Pt
03 The Refreshment

Count the beers

Beer Bonus: Subtract 15 minutes from your time for every standard beer consumed throughout the day.

Deduction Rate −15 Mins / Beer
